meta.title: Lysomba — Your groceries, sorted by aisle
meta.description: Lysomba files every item under the right aisle of your store. One clean walk through the shop, and the total adds itself up. Free Android app, no sign-up, works offline.

hero.subtitle: Lysomba files every item under the right aisle of your store. One clean walk through the shop, and the total adds itself up as you go.

features.title: Built for the way you actually shop
features.lead: No account to create, no ten-minute tutorial. You add the items, the app files them.

cards.title: Every item in its aisle
cards.text: Produce, butcher, dry goods… your items group themselves in the order of the store.

cards.title: Budget under control
cards.text: Add a price and the total updates with every item — including what is already in the cart.

cards.title: As many lists as you need
cards.text: Weekly shop, Saturday drinks, the click-and-collect run: each with its own store and total.

cards.title: English and French
cards.text: The app follows your phone's language: interface and aisle names in English or French.

stores.title: Your supermarket isn't laid out like mine
stores.lead: Save your stores and the order of their aisles. Lysomba then sorts your list in the exact order of your route — from the first aisle to the checkout.

items.title: Create your list
items.text: Name it, pick the store, or start from one of your templates.

items.title: Add your items
items.text: Quantity, price if you like. The aisle is guessed as you type.

items.title: Tick them off in store
items.text: You follow the aisles in order and the total keeps up.

items.a: Yes. Download the app and build your lists — no account, no subscription.

items.q: Which languages does the app support?
items.a: English and French. Lysomba follows your phone's language, aisle names included.

items.q: Do I need a connection in store?
items.a: No. Your lists stay on your phone and work even at the back of the frozen aisle.

items.q: What if an item lands in the wrong aisle?
items.a: Move it with one tap, and Lysomba remembers it for next time.

downloadCta.lead: Install Lysomba, build your first list tonight, and win back twenty minutes on Saturday morning.
